verdict.rationale: Reflect's import/export docs say users "can always export it into an open format (like HTML or Markdown)," which covers on-demand export in open formats. The docs do not say whether the export includes the entire knowledge base (attachments, backlinks, history), and no hands-on report confirms it works. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the export covers the whole knowledge base including attachments and link structure, step-by-step export docs, independent or hands-on corroboration that a complete export succeeds.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can export my entire knowledge base at any time in open formats, so leaving is as easy as arriving

citations.quote: you can always export it into an open format (like HTML or Markdown).
